bug: React NotFoundError: Failed to execute removeChild on Node
root_cause: An external Android/browser translation layer reparents a React-owned text node under a font wrapper. A later React commit removes or inserts the node using its original parent and the browser raises NotFoundError.

red_evidence.scenario: Wrap the route text node in an external font element, then trigger a React state transition that removes it.
red_evidence.result_before_fix: The ErrorBoundary rendered the crash screen with NotFoundError. Existing translate=no metadata and page-local workarounds did not enforce DOM ownership globally.

green_evidence.lint: Passed for domOwnershipGuard.ts, main.tsx, and ErrorBoundary.test.tsx
green_evidence.build: Production and public frontend builds passed

production.console_recovery: [LocalOS] Recovered external DOM ownership conflict during removeChild.

scope_guard: Recovery applies only when the expected parent and externally moved node are inside a registered LocalOS React root. Native NotFoundError behavior remains unchanged outside that root.
